scientific_integrity: An unbounded combinatorial proof, corroborated by exact-integer tests. The bibliographic comparison is limited to inspected literature; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only divisibility of central trinomial coefficients by 9; it does not determine exact valuations at 27 or beyond. General automaton methods might encode the same language implicitly.
title: An exact ternary-language criterion for nine dividing central trinomial numbers
